observation: Repaired geometry, inspected fresh. Top: the 24 lane tiles make one continuous disc in strict light/dark alternation and close on a single clean circle; no tile is notched, scalloped, bayed or short, and no orange flame root shows anywhere inside that circle. The centre bar is a clear open platform, the four bank boundaries read as the wider ones, and the counters sit on their own tiles at the five radial stations. Outside the circle, 38 slender flames curl off the rim, all the same way round, each leaving the disc on a sharp V, narrowing at once and ending in a blunt curled tip - no needle and no spike. The hero arch closes its loop at the lower rim with the skirt running on underneath it. Iso: every flame top is a single flat facet falling outward from the deck line to a low tip, with a straight crisp crease where it meets each vertical flank and no rounding or blending. Front: one low slab; tiles stand proud of the body, counters stack on the tile tops, the underside is flat on the bed and the rim steps down and out. No floating geometry, no cantilever, no counter/tile/tongue intersection; part count, placement, proportion and orientation match the 55-part set.
